How Things Are Going Now

Alibaba operates a vast commercial digital ecosystem across mainland China and international markets. The business currently generates a real-time annualized revenue run-rate of $150,463.2M based on latest quarterly revenue of $37,615.8M (+8.6% YoY), supported by a consolidated gross margin of 38.2%. Operational volume scale remains immense, maintaining Over 1.0 Billion Annual Active Consumers across the Taobao-Tmall Commerce Group and over 300 Million Monthly Active Users on the Qwen AI Consumer Interface.

The current operational trajectory reflects a multi-speed structural shift. Legacy e-commerce Customer Management Revenue is experiencing minor unadjusted contraction (-7% YoY unadjusted / +1% like-for-like) as BABA reallocates user traffic toward Quick Commerce (Freshippo and Taobao Instant Commerce), which expanded +45% YoY to RMB 53.3 billion. In parallel, Cloud Intelligence Group is accelerating: external cloud revenue grew +45% YoY, driven by AI-related product revenue delivering triple-digit YoY growth for 12 consecutive quarters to reach an annualized run-rate of ~$7.3 billion (~35% of external cloud revenue).

However, funding this technological repositioning has significantly altered cash generation. Quarterly CapEx rose 75% YoY to $10.0 billion (RMB 67.7 billion), pushing quarterly Free Cash Flow into negative territory (-$6.58 billion). To maintain balance sheet liquidity for its 3-year RMB 380 billion ($53B+) AI/Cloud infrastructure roadmap without adding un-hedged debt, management temporarily paused share repurchases and executed an HK$80 billion ($10.2 billion) primary share placement in Hong Kong, diluting share count by ~3.7%.
